items.question: Where must the water-pot and water-vessel be positioned relative to the deity?
premises: The ritual procedure specifies placement of vessels around the deity.
The water-pot is associated with the head region.
The water-vessel is associated with the foot place.
items.inference: The water-pot is to be placed at the head region and the water-vessel at the foot place.
uncertainties: The implied verb of placing is supplied from the preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: Place the water-pot at the head region and the water-vessel at the foot place.
